notes: Man in tan jacket walks out toward right/camera; man in blue-white puffer plus one companion appear close to camera heading into room, entry point not seen.
Busy minute; two early passers close to camera (red sweater, blue coat) counted as arrivals by heading only; two men with bags leave.
Trio from previous minute leaves; group of three appears close to camera in bottom row and one stands blocking part of view.
Heavy two-way traffic close to camera; several faint figures behind the propped glass leaf; directions partly inferred from facing.
Backpack man with red bag and woman in long black coat seem to step behind the glass and come back; three men in caps gather in bottom row.
Man in brown beanie stands close to camera from mid-strip; woman in blue beanie lingers behind the glass leaf.
Brown-beanie man blocks much of the view for the first two rows.
Two people pass close to camera heading into the room early on; a figure in a blue beanie stays behind the glass leaf.
Mid-strip cluster passes close to camera; directions judged from facing only.
Steady flow in the last third with people close to camera; woman in blue beanie moves between glass leaf and room and is not recounted.
Men talking close to camera block the edge in middle row; older woman in cream jacket enters at the end.
Wave of people heading out past the camera in top row; blue-beanie woman and woman in cream jacket go behind the glass leaf; at least one passer may have stayed in the room.
Group near the door disappears between rows without a clear exit being seen; person in cream jacket returns and stands at the door edge.
Quiet minute; woman with ponytail and woman in blue beanie each walk out toward camera/right; person in cream jacket hovers at door edge then walks in to pet the dog.
Older man in grey jacket comes in and later walks out; group of three enters at the end.
The group of three from the previous minute walks back out; third person only seen faintly behind the glass.
Couple enters, then a woman in a grey scarf with one companion close to camera; room empty afterwards.
String of arrivals passing close to camera in middle row; woman with tote walks back to the door area late and hovers there.
Woman with tote, man in brown jacket and man in black jacket leave in turn; one lingers behind the glass leaf before going.

Group in beanies walks out past camera, then a man in a black hooded jacket; woman in orange hat with fur collar arrives and stands at door edge; long-haired woman who was hovering at the door walks back in.
Mixed two-way traffic close to camera and several figures behind the glass leaf; directions partly inferred.
Man in beanie and grey jacket enters at end of middle row; woman with fur collar stands near the door without clearly crossing.
Two men walk out in first tiles and a woman in a puffer passes close to camera heading right; one man stands still at left for the whole minute.
Woman in blue cap with blue bag enters; woman in blue beanie leaves; three young men enter close to camera in bottom row.
Woman in blue cap comes in from the right again (seems to have stepped out); man in long coat and man in cap follow; one man passing close to camera heading right counted as a departure.
Man in long coat leaves toward camera; several single arrivals; woman in white beanie appears at right edge in last tile.
Girl with headband enters with the white-beanie woman already counted last strip; man with cup who stood by the door goes behind the glass leaf.
Older woman in cream jacket walks out; man in cream jacket and woman in maroon beanie enter at end of middle row.
White-beanie woman and girl with headband leave; a small group stands right at the door edge most of the minute without clearly crossing.
Group enters close to camera (yellow beanie, curly-haired woman, man in cap, one more); people standing at the door edge partly hide the opening.
Large group with a dog comes in during the middle row while a woman with a green bag blocks much of the tile; two more women enter at the end.
People cluster at the door edge and others stand close to camera; one man in a cap appears at the door mid-strip; a pair of legs crossing the bottom early could not be assigned a direction.
Crowded near the door; woman with green bag and dog seems to head out, one man enters; a man in rust trousers loiters at the door edge.
Woman in beige coat and friend with shopping bags leave past the camera, then man in brown jacket; quiet afterwards.
Man in cream jacket goes to the door mid-strip and walks back in about 40 s later; four women enter close to camera in the final tiles.
Blonde woman stands close to camera by the door for the top row; masked woman with fur collar, yellow-beanie man and curly-haired woman leave.
Several arrivals from behind close to camera in the middle row; woman in headscarf then stands near the lens; a figure stays behind the glass leaf throughout.
